name: royalsmarine-tech-asm
description: Royals Marine — Aquaculture & Field CRM monorepo

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true, force:true})"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
